title: InteractionInstance
description:
A live offer of one definition to one audience.

Binds the routing nonce to the definition's content id, the revision, the TTL, the scope, the frozen responder policy, and the provenance — and the whole binding is itself content-addressed, so an offer cannot be altered without changing its [`InstanceId`].

definition.description: The definition being offered — its exact form digest.

nonce.description: Fresh, unguessable routing handle. Not the identity.

ttl_ticks.description: Ticks after `provenance.minted_tick` at which this offer expires.

Audience.description: Who may answer, as distinct from what a surface can draw.

oneOf.description: The operator at the terminal that owns this session.

Provenance.description:
Where an instance came from — the record's own sources.

Mandatory, not optional. The repo's one outstanding first-principle violation is exactly this hole in `ConversationTurn` (`first_principle.rs:802`); a new record type that cannot name its origin repeats the defect the ledger counts.

minted_tick.description: The tick at which it was minted, as the host counts ticks.

origin.description: What minted this instance (a tool name, a subsystem, a persona).

ResponderPolicy.description:
The frozen eligibility rule for one instance.

Frozen at publication: an offer cannot widen who may answer it after the fact, which is the "attenuate, never amplify" law applied to responders.

audiences.description: Audiences this offer is open to.

requires_assertion.description: Whether the responder must present an authenticated assertion.

Scope.description: The workspace fence an instance is confined to.

conversation_id.description: The conversation this instance belongs to.

workspace_key.description: Opaque workspace key — the same fence every permission query already applies in `newt_core`'s store.
